name: Workshop defect counts
productType: Excel summary, CSV dataset, and DAX measures
summary: Defects found by product line. A defect is a unit that failed the check.
description: Defects found by product line. A defect is a unit that failed the check. Load the CSV into Excel or Power BI Desktop. The DAX file is text you paste into a measure. This package does not include a PBIX file.
benefits: A CSV with a real grain and sample rows
DAX that names the columns in that CSV
An Excel total you can check against the rows
compatibility: Excel for the workbook and CSV
Power BI Desktop if you paste the DAX yourself
disclaimer: The workbook and CSV are sample data for learning the model. A PBIX file is not included. Paste the DAX into Power BI Desktop after you load the CSV. This is not a financial audit.
